stubs.body:
Two calm nights means the deal is working, so we keep it.

**Give Sunday its own ending.** Sunday has a different shape, so agree its stop on Saturday and let Ava write it on the fridge.

**Add nothing at the end, again.** The same words as the good nights: "That was the deal. Well done."

Your check in says getting there, so Coming off screens stays on it, and in four days I will ask again. The words are still in [The stopping point agreed in a calm moment](/dashboard/scripts/9671).

**Tonight.** Ask Ava which Sunday ending feels fair to her.

actions.text: We agreed the ending like you said. Two good nights, then Sunday was a fight again.
